tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor bzlog chen bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ rgyal ba'i mtshan mchog gtsug tor las/ /legs 'khrungs rmad byung lha mo che/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa de la 'dud/ /'dir gdugs dkar gyi bzlog chen ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang paṇa chen rin po ches mgron mtshan rnams phyogs gcig bsdebs pa'i bsdus pa dang*/ sde tshan du byas pa'i 'bring po zhig bshad nas/ yang sde tshan rnams kyang so sor phye ba'i rgyas pa bya tshul zhig kha 'phangs pa rnams las/ 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas 'chad pa la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sa gzhi byi dor byas pa'i steng du thig gsar du 'debs pa'i stegs ji ltar 'tsham pa'i steng du 'jog rgyu'i dkyil 'khor dbus su sor bzhis bskor ba'i zlum po/ de yang phyed nas bgos te lte ba ljang khu dang*/ phyed du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir sor bzhi bsnan pas bskor ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa rtsibs kyi bar rnams ser po/ de'i phyir sor bzhis bskor ba la rdo rje rgya gram/ shar rwa sogs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang*/ de'i phyir sor bzhis bskor ba la sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir sor bzhis bskor ba la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po/ de'i phyir phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lngas gru bzhir bskor ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi bar dang bcas pa shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang khu/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod snam dmar por sgo dang sgo 'khyud sogs kyi bar rnams phyogs mdog dbus kyi lte bar tshon spungs dkar po cung che ba/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i tshan spungs/ de nas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i byang shar nas brtsams te shar du ser sngo ljang dmar/ lhor dkar ser nag ljang*/ nub tu dmar ser dkar ljang*/

byang du dmar dkar ljang ser ba'i tshon spungs/ 'khor lo 'di'i shar gyi shar dang nub kyi nub tu tshon spungs dkar po re bya/ 'on kyang tsan+ḍa go mi'i gzhung dang paṇa chen gyi der 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa mi gsal yang*/ rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig nas bshad pas rgyas bsdus su mngon/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i tshon spungs shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ /byang ser ba/ shar rwa'i g.yas g.yon gyi rwa so so la tshangs pa yab yum gyi tshon spungs ser po/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la shar du brgya byin nas byang shar du lha chen bar shar ser lho sngo nub dmar byang ljang*/ shar lhor dmar/ lho nub tu sngo/ nub byang du ljang*/ /byang shar du dkar ba/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar du 'byung po/ lhor gza'/ nub tu sa bdag byang du lha min/ shar lhor mi'am ci/ lho nub tu mkha' 'gro ma/ nub byang du ma mo/ byang shar du mkha' lding gi tshon spungs phyogs mdog kha cig sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i tshon spungs bya bar bshad pa ni brtag par bya ste/ gong du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa bzhin rgyal chen bzhi'i tshon spungs bya bar bshad zin cing*/ paṇa chen gyi der sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i tshon spungs med par shar sgo'i phyi'i shar du lto 'phye/ lhor rnal 'byor ma/ nub tu klu/ byang du 'byung po dang*/ gzhan gdon spyi'i tshon spungs bya bar bshad la/ slong dpon tsan+ḍa go mi'i gzhung du sgo bzhir lto 'phye sogs bzhi dgod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ / mi gsal yang 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i tshon spungs sngar ltar ma lcogs na'ang phyogs mdog byas chog par sems/ de ni cung zad rgyas ba'i rnam gzhag yin la glo bur du bya ba'i tshe sngar ltar ma grub na/ paṇa chen gyi gsung ltar/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du tshon spungs dgod pa ni bsdus pa'am/ dmigs bsal yin pas shes par bya'o/ /mtha'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du chos 'byung me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su legs ldan mched gsum gyi tshon spungs nag po dgod/

gtor ma yang so gsum gyi dang po/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la 'bum rgyu dkar gtor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i spungs gtor/ gnyis pa chos skyong la 'bul gtor zur gsum/ gsum pa legs ldan mched gsum la yang dmar gtor gsum/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag la pad 'dab can/ lnga pa 'phreng ba za ba'i tshangs gdon la bo de tse dang rag sha drug ba dri za ba'i gdon yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas la zho 'o mar sogs mngar gsum/ bdun ba 'bras bu za ba 'phags skyes po 'khor bcas la shing thog sna tshogs/ brgyad pa skyug pa za ba mi mig bzang 'khor bcas la sprang rtsi/ dgu ba bdug pa za ba rnams sras 'khor bcas la sbyar spos/ tshangs pa dang rgyal chen bzhi la grub na dmar gtor rang rang gi mgo brnyan yod pa bya bar bshad/ bcu ba mngal za ba brgya byin 'khor bcas sbrang bu ram ka ra ste mngar gsum/ bcu gcig pa bsreg bya ba za me lha la 'bras yos 'bras zan/ bcu gnyis pa sha za ba gshin rje la ra lug sogs kyi rlig pa bton pa sha brjen dang btsos pa/ bcu gsum pa rkang za ba srin po la rkang mar/ bcu bzhi pa me tog za ba dbang phyug la me tog sna tshogs dang rtsi bcud/ bco lnga pa mchil ma za ba klu la sbrang rtsi/ bcu drug pa me tog za ba rlung lha la snye ma dang 'bru sna tshogs/ bcu bdun pa gtor ma za ba gnod sbyin la 'khur ba/ bco brgyad pa mi gtsang ba za ba 'byung po la phug sgog btsong*/ bcu dgu pa tshil za ba gza' la phyi tshil nang tshil/ nye shu pa 'bras yos za ba rgyu skar la dkar gsum/ nyer gcig pa snabs za ba sa bdag la bya mo'i sgo nga*/ nyer gnyis pa rnag za ba lha min la sha rul/ nyer gsum pa ngar snabs za ba mi'am ci la bya pho'i sgo nga*/ nyer bzhi pa zhag za ba ma mo la zhaganyer lnga pa khrag sna mthung ba mkha' 'gro la khrag sna/ nyer drug pa stong khung nas 'bab pa mthung ba chu lha la chu sna sna tshogs/ nyer bdun pa btsas pa za ba mkha' lding la bu ram dang shing kun/

nyer brgyad pa gcin 'thung ba sren mo bzhi la rgun chang 'bras/ nyer dgu pa lhag ma za ba srin mo la lhag ma kun bsags pa/ sum cu pa dri za ba lto 'phye la bzang drug sogs sman sna/ so gcig pa 'byung po spyi la dkar gtor/ so gnyis pa rigs drug dang glo bur du lhag pa rnams la yang dkar gtor/ so gsum pa phyogs bzhi'i bgegs rnams la bgegs gtor ting lo 'chang bu bcas dmar po/ gzhan yang mi mo sogs kyi klud du ma dang*/ zor 'phen na tsan+ḍa go mi'i skabs 'di'i gzhung las ma bshad kyang*/ des bzlog pa'i zor bya ba'i cho ga las sgo nga dang mda' 'ug pa ma skyer ba'i mde'u can bzhi dang*/ khrag phor bzhir dug dang zor gyi sna du ma blugs pa'i snod bzhi dang*/ dmar gtor cha bzhi dang zhes bshad cing*/ phyag len du mda' 'ug sgro ma mde'u can bzhi dang*/ skyes pa'i gzhu gcig bya sgong khrag blugs pa bzhi/ rdor zur gsum chung ba bzhi/ dmar gtor zur gsum la tsher ma btsugs pa bzhi/ yungs kar sgang bu rkyen bzhi rnams byas nas zor du 'phen pa ltar yang rung ngo*/ gzhan yang chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs mchod pa rgyas pa'am/ tshar gsum dang*/ rdor dril dung rnga sbub sogs kyang sta gon bya'o/ 7 gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po bdag bskyed la gdugs dkar phyag stong spyan stong ma dang*/ phyag brgyad ma/ phyag drug ma/ phyag bzhi ma/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnams las 'dir dang po'i dbang du byas nas brjod par bya ste/ bskyed tshul la lha drug bskyed dang*/ cho ga gsum bskyed gnyis las paṇa chen dang de'i rjes 'brang gi cho ga dag las lha drug bskyed mdzad c-ing*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs yin na de nyid legs mod/ 'on kyang rgya gzhung gzhan dang 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams dang bod gzhung dag las cho ga gsum bskyed mdzad 'dug pa ltar 'di yang 'jug pa bde ba'i ched de bzhin du bshad par bya'o/

/de yang sngon du tshogs zhing byas na legs pas de'i tshul na skyabs 'gro sems skyed tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bla ma mchog gsum thams cad dang*/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs la/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du yang*/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇā+e ṣa si ta ta pa tre sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag gis bgyis dang bgyid 'gyur gyi/ /sdig ltung thams cad so sor bshags/ /skye 'phags kun gyis dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don phyir srid mtha'i bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge ba sems can kun don phyir/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thims pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ swā bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ las gdugs dkar po'i tog la oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug gtor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ sprul ba'i dbu stong dang phyag stong mnga' ba/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i tshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad pa/ sku mdog dkar po/ sgeg cing dpa' ba'i nyams can gyi rtsa zhal nyis brgya dkar po/ 'jigs su rung ba dang rgod pa'i nyams can gyi g.yas zhal nyis brgya ser po/

gshe ba dang rngams pa'i nyams can gyi rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar po/ snying rje ba dang zhi ba'i nyams can gyi g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang khu/ ngo mtshar ba dang drag po'i nyams can gyi steng zhal nyis brgya sngon po/ zhal re re la yang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu re re la khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar bas mtshan pa/ dbu'i steng du gdung bdun dang bde gshegs bcu la sogs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun gyi cod pan 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin dang/ mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar bo'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yas g.yon gyi lhag ma dgu bcu rtsa dgu na 'khor lo dang mda'/ g.yas kyi phyag lhag ma bzhi brgyas rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rin chen pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje rnams brgya phrag re re 'dzin cing*/ g.yon gyi phyag lhag ma bzhi brgyas rim pa bzhin du gzhu ral gri zhags pa lcags kyu rnams brgya phrag re re 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar gyi stong g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyangs pas rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po thams cad gnon par mdzad cing*/ g.yon lnga brgya bskums pas mdangs 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad 'jom par mdzad pa/ sku'i cha thams cad na zur gyis lta ba dang*/ cher bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'gyu ba dang*/ drag tu gzer ba la sogs pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ gar dgu'i nyams dag ldan cing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bskal ba'i me lta bu'i rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par 'gengs pas sems can thams cad 'jigs pa ma lus pa las skyob pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ de'i g.yas g.yon rgyab gsum du pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan la hūṃ nag po las legs ldan nag po chen po/

legs ldan drag po/ legs ldan sred med kyi bu ste legs ldan ched gsum sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs dkar 'dzin cing*/ mchan khung g.yon na tsan dan gyi be chen bsnams pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ zhabs la sag lham nag khra gsol ba/ khros shing gtum pa/ thod pa bskam rlon gyis brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi sbyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi ye shes pa dang legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre ma hā ka la sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams sbyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas oṃ sarba nas shrī ye hūṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur pas lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rnam snang gis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa amṛ tas bsangs swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo rnams dwangs shingathogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī si ta ta pa tre sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta'i bar sbyar nas mchod la/ rgyal ba kun gyi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sprul ba'i dbu dang phyag ni stong mnga' zhing*/ /bye ba brgya stong ldan pa'i dpa' mo gang*/ /phas rgol 'joms la thogs med mthu ldan cing*/ /mi phyed 'bar ba'i rtags 'chang de la 'dud/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa'i/ /gtum po rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar byas rgyal ba thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ zhes nye snying dang snying po gang mang dam ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la bed du dzaḥ bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la du tri bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ṣ-i ga na bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci 'grub bzla paṇa chen gyi der sngags dang po mi 'byung ba ni chad pa yin te/ rgya gzhung gzhan na gsum ka snang ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas yig brgya brjod cing*/ slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas/ dge ba 'di'i zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ ༈ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed de ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang*/ dam tshig pa ma bskyed par ye shes pa sbyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol ba gang byas kyang mi 'gal yang*/ 'dir paṇa chen sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar dam tshig pa mi bskyed par ye shes pa nyid sbyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol ba bzhin bya ste/

sgrub bzhi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhās stongs par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng gi dbus su ri rab gru bzhi pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ dkar po las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas pa rdzogs par grub par gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje yi/ /mtshan mchog gtsug tor las 'khrungs bcom ldan ma/ /rgyal yul gdugs dkar 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /sbyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /legs ldan nag po mched gsum dang*/ /gzhan yang dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /bstan dang bdag cag don gyi phyir/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lha chen tshangs pa 'khor bcas dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang lha chen brgyad/ /klu chen brgyad dang gza' chen brgyad/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad 'jigs byed dgu/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po dang*/ /sa bdag lha min sha za dang*/ /mi'am ci dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnal 'byor ma dang ma mo'i tshogs/ /dri za mkha' lding lto 'phye che/ /gdon bgegs bu lon chags pa sogs/ /srid gsum 'byung po thams cad kyang*/ / mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre shrī ma hā kā la dharma pā la dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra e h+ye hi badz+ra ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlogs pa chen mo/

zhes pa nas 'jigs pa ma lus pa las skyob pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab dang*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i rtsibs rnams su drag shul chen mo la sogs pa'i nyer gnyis phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar rwa'i g.yas g.yon la tshangs pa yab yum/ phyogs bzhi'i rwa rnams su rgyal chen bzhi/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha chen brgyad/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la 'byung po dang gza' la sogs pa'i sde brgyad/ sgo dang sgo'i phyi rol tu lto 'phye la sogs pa'i sde bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon don lnga'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ phyi rol tu legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ud bha wa ya swāhā/ zhes brjod de gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas mchod pa rnams sngags kyis bsangs/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las zhes pa nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ oṃ ru pa āḥhūṃ nas spar+sha āḥhūṃ dang*/ oṃ ma hā sap+ta rat+na āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ ma lus zhing gi mchod tshogs dang*/ /bdag gis 'bul ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs dang*/ /gtsang rigs dpal mgon don lnga sogs/ /srid zhi'i mgron rnams kun la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta ba tre shrī ma hā ka la sarba dharma pā ya lo ka pā ya sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil sogs dang pāt+yaṃ sogs sbyar nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ bdag gis 'bul ba'i gzugs mchog 'di/ /zhes dang sgra dri ro reg mchog dang*/ rū ba sogs sbyar nas 'dod yon lnga dang*/

lha rdzas 'khor lo rin chen 'di/ /bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs dang*/ /srin zhi'i mgron rnams kun la 'bul/ /bar chad bzlog phyir bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas tsakra rat+na zhes sogs sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ lha rdzas rgyal srin sna bdun 'di/ /bcom ldan nas ma hā sab+ta rat+na pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod de 'bul lo/ /de nas rgyal ba bye ba 'dun dang 'phags pa'i 'khor/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa rgyas pa dang*/ bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras khros pa'i skur bstan nas/ /bstan dgra dam nyams gdon bgegs 'joms mdzad pa/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gtum chen legs ldan mched la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid pa 'di na gnas dang rgyu ba'i gtso/ /rgyal chen phyogs skyong lha chen klu chen dang*/ /'jigs byed gza' skar gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal gus pas bstod/ /de nas gtor ma dang po bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si ta ta pa tre sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyi 'bul la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ rgyal ba kun gyi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul ba'i dbu dang phyag ni stong mnga' zhing*/ /bye ba brgya stong spyan ldan dpa' mo gang*/ /phas rgol 'joms la thogs med mthu ldan
pa'i/ /ma phyed 'bar ba'i rtags 'chang de la 'dud/ /tses bstod/ gnyis pa chos skyo

nga spyi sgo kyi gtor ma bla med ltar byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba'am/ yang na gong ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la sa pa ri wa ra nas khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum dang ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ nang mchod yod na 'bul/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bar gcod srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces pa'am/ rgyas par na rang rang gi gzhung ltar bya/ de nas legs ldan gyi gtor ma brlabs te/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi nas gsol bar gyur/ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta sogs lan bdun dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ nang mchod kyang phul/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ gtum po rnams la bdag bstod do/ /zhes bstod/ de nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hū/ phas rgol 'joms la mthu ldan lha mo dang*/ /drag shul che sogs 'jigs rung phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /bdud 'dul legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mthun pa'i mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gdon dang rgyu skar gza' yi gnod pa dang*/ /dus min 'chi dang sdig pa'i rmi lam dang/ /dug mtshon me dang chu dgra'i 'jigs pa sogs/ / khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis bzlog par mdzod/ /rlung mkhris ban kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams dang*/ /mdze dang phol mig g.yan pa lhog pa dang*/ /gzhogs phyed na sogs rims nad mtha' dag dang*/ /lha klu lha min la sogs gdon chen rnams/ /khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis=/ /srog dang gzi brjid mdangs rnams 'phrog pa dang*/ /mngal dang sha khrag la sogs za ba dang*/

/nyin re ba sogs rim gyi gnod pa dang*/ /dmag dang choms rkun rgyal po'i 'jigs pa sogs/ khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis=/ /seng ge stag sogs gcan gzan gnod pa dang*/ /gzhan yang gdon chen rigs rnams mtha' dag dang*/ /kun tu rgyu dang tshangs ba sred med bu/ /drang srong dmod pa grub pa'i ngan sngags sogs/ /khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis=/ /mdor na rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pas bskyed pa rnams/ /gzhan gyis bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub pa dang*/ /lus srog longs spyod tshe yi bar gcod rnams/ /khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis=/ /gang gis sgo nas mi bsrun skye bo yis/ /bdag cag bde legs 'phrog pa'i rig sngags sogs/ /ma lus gcad dang 'bar ba'i phur bu yis/ /de dag rnams la gdab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bstan pa bshig cing dkon mchog dmod pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /'bar ba'i phur bus thal bar brlag par mdzod/ /de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma sngar ltar brlabs nas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshes pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod de/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di/ / sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs/ /stong gsum gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ /khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid dang*/ /gnas khang 'di ru gnas bcas pa'i/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis/ /las dang bya ba ci byas kyang*/ /ko long phrag dog mi mdzad par/ /mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas mi za dgu za sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma nyer dgu po lnga tshan gcig brgyad tshan gnyis/ yang lnga tshan gcig gsum tshan gcig lan chags gtor na bcas bshams la/

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor thams cad mgron rnams rang rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'dod rgu'i yo byad phun gsum tshogs pa mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe dharma te badz+ra sid+dhi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tat+khaṃ ut+ga ta spa ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥ nā ad+ya nut+pan na tod ta/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes sngags drug dang phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ dang po lnga tshan dang po la/ oṃ prah+ma ṇa ye/ oṃ tsa tur ma hā rā dzā sa pa ri wa ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shā mu khe bh+ya sarba tat+khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi mi ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ /zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis bsngos la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ tshangs pa yab yum 'khor bcas dang*/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam mthos sras/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ /zas su 'phreng ba srog 'bras bu/ /skyug pa bdug pa za ba yi/ /gdon tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gtor ma ni/ /'bru bcud sbyar ba 'di 'bul bas/ /so so'i gdon bgegs nad rims dang*/ /tshe srog bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /gnyis pa brgyad tshan dang po la/ oṃ in+d+ra ye/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ ya ma ye/ oṃ ni ri te ye/ oṃ ma hā shwa ri/ oṃ nā ga rā dza/ oṃ ba yu be ye/ oṃ ku be ra ye sa pa ri wa ra na maḥ zhes sogs sngar ltar bsngos nas/ hūṃ/ dbang po me lha gshin rje srin/ /lha klu rlung lha gnod sbyin ni/

/yab yum sras dang g.yog rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ /zas su mngal bsreg sha rkang dang*/ /me tog 'chil ma lo tog dang*/ /'khur ba za ba'i gdon rnams la/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'bru bcud sbyar ba 'di 'bul bas/ /so so'i gdon bgegs nad rims dang*/ /lo nyes ngan sngags gnod pa dang*/ /tshe srog bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /gsum pa brgyad tshan gnyis pa yang*/ oṃ bhu ta a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ sarba gra ha bh+yaḥ oṃ sarbā nak+ṣa mi tra/ oṃ bhu mi ba ti/ oṃ a su ra bh+yaḥ oṃ gi na re bh+yaḥ oṃ ma tri na ye bh+yaḥ oṃ ḍā ki ni bh+ya sa pa ri wa ra sogs kyis sngar bzhin phul nas/ 'byung po gza' tshogs rgyu skar dang*/ /sa bdag lha min mi'am ci/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ /zas su mi gtsang tshil dkar gsum/ /snabs rnag ngar snabs zhag dang ni/ /khrag 'thung ba yi gdon rnams la/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /'bru bcud sbyar ba 'di 'bul bas/ /so so'i gdon bgegs nad rims dang*/ /gza' gdon mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ /tshe srog bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ bzhi pa lnga mtshan gnyis pa yang*/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye bh+yaḥ oṃ ga ru ḍa bh+yaḥ oṃ tsa tur bh+yo bh+yaḥ oṃ rak+ṣa se bh+yaḥ oṃ ma ho ra ge bh+ya sa pa ri wa ra na maḥ sogs kyis lan gsum phul nas/ klu chogs mkha' lding sring mo bzhi/ /rnal 'byor ma dang srin mo rnams/ /lto 'phye'i tshogs rnams 'khor bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ /zas su stong khur 'bab 'thung dang*/ /btsas za gcin 'thung lhag ma dang*/ /dri nyid za ba'i gdon rnams la/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ 'bru bcud sbyar ba 'di 'bul bas/ /so so'i gdon bgegs nad rims dang*/ /'og gdon mi nad phyugs nad dang*/ /tshes srog bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /lnga pa la gsum gyi dang po sngar gyi de dag tu ma 'dus pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po spyi dang khyad par lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba la/

oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swāhā/ oṃ gung gung swāhā/ sa pa ri wa ra na maḥ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pa'i/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad dang*/ /lan chags sha 'khon gnyer rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang*/ /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dang*/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dang*/ /steng 'og bar gsum dbye ba yi/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /bsad dang bcings dang brdeg pa dang*/ /phrogs dang rku ba la sogs pa'i/ /lan chags sha 'khon gnyair ba dang*/ /bu lon chags pa rnams la bsngo/ /gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor rgyun chod la/ /bu lon sha 'khon dag par bgyis/ /gnyis pa rigs drug thams cad dang glo bur du lhag pa rnams la/ /na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ gzhan yang drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /rigs drug sems can thams cad dang*/ /skal chad glo bur lhag rnams la/ /bsngo zhing sbyin pas tshim gyur nas/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyud gang zhing*/ /nyon mongs g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol/ /gsum pa phyogs bzhi'i bgegs 'khor bcas la/ oṃ sarba bighān bh+ya sa pa ri wa ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs lan gsu ma gyis phul nas ar+ghaṃ sogs gyis mchod de/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ/ khams gsum bdag po spyin sgron ma/ /rdo rje bi na ya ka sogs/ /phyogs bzhi'i bgegs tshogs thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod gtor 'bul/ /gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha brjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnams pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ljon shing gel ba sogs gnas par/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /

bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras 'chan 'bras bu mang po dang*/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /de ring phan chad bskyed par bgyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag sdoms la tshangs par spyod/ / 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge spyong de yin bram ze'ang de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung du gang dag gi /lus ma mngon par gnod gyur ba'i/ /nad de nye bar sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi/ /dam tshig mnos la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi 'dod pa bskong bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /'dir ni sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /bar gcod nye bar sol mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /zhes bsgra de nas/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas dang*/ /dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor bcas kyis/ /mthun pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes nas/ /rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gzhan gyi bsam spyod ngan pa dang*/ /tshe zor yungs zor 'phen pa zlog /zhes pa nas mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod/ bsdu na/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas kyis/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu bzlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog /rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad= /lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg= /rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa= /god kha god 'dre thams cad= /rbad 'dre rbod gtong thams cad= /mi 'dod mi shis thams cad=

/mdor na rnal 'byor sbyin bdag la/ /gnod pa'i mi mthun phyogs zhi zhing*/ /tshe dpal stobs 'byor snyan grags sogs/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /de nas slar sngar gyi gtor ma rnams kha gsos te gdugs dkar 'khor bcas la gong ltar 'bul ba'am/ ma grub kyang chog la/ zhag gnyis gsum tsam la byed na de bstun gyis bzod gsol dang brtan bzhugs sogs bya tshul shis dgos shing*/ gzhan 'di yan gyis grub kyang mjug tu zor 'phen na/ sngar kyi zor dag mdun du bzhag nas bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ las zor rnams thog dang mtshon cha me rab tu 'bar ba dgra bgegs bar gcod thams cad bzlog pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ hūṃ/ bde gshegs gtsug tor legs 'khrungs shing*/ /sa gsum skrag mdzad bcom ldan ma/ / 'jigs rung phyag rgya'i tshogs bcas pas/ /zor chen rdzas kyi stobs bskyed cig /legs ldan mched gsum tshangs pa dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /dregs pa sde brgyad bcas pas kyang*/ /zor chen na= /de nas/ da ni zor 'phen dgra la 'phen/ /da ni zor 'phen gdon la 'phen/ /da ni zo 'phen bgegs la 'phen/ /da ni zor kha dgra la bsgyur/ /da ni zor kha gdon la= /da ni zor kha bgegs la= /bh+yo bh+yo/ de ni dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo de ni bgegs la bh+yoḥ zhes brjod cing zor bsgyur byas nas/ /zor rnams sgo phyogs su kha phyir bstan te/ de nas legs ldan dang*/ /tshangs pa dang*/ rgyal chen gyi gtor ma rnams kyang bsgrigs cing*/ mi za dgu za'i gtor ro sogs phyir bskyal ba'i sta gon byas nas bsgrigs/ gser skyems oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ hū/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas sogs/ /rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad kyis/ /gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi mgon skyobs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs pa/

/'jig rten skyong ba kun gyis kyang*/ gser bdag gi=/ /lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ /yul 'di'i gnas bdag kun gyis kyang*/ /gser= /bdag= /de nas rnal 'byor ba bzhengs nas/ hūṃ/ nyi zla gza' dang rgyu skar tshogs rnams dang*/ /tshangs pa la sogs steng na gnas pa yi/ /mtho ba'i lha rnams thams cad zhabs bskums la/ /de ring rnal 'byor bdag la zor lam dbye/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma 'khor bcas dang*/ /gdengs can dbang po klu gnyan sa bdag sogs/ /'og na gnas pa kun kyang dbu 'chums la/ /de ring =/ /dbang bo me lha gshin rje srin po sogs/ /phyogs dang mtshams na gnas pa thams cad dang*/ /dri za la sogs bar snang gnas pa rnams/ /g.yas dang g.yon du cung zad gzur mdzod la/ de ring = /dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor bcas thams cad dang*/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyen po 'khor bcas kyis/ /ko long rung nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /de rin rnal 'byor bdag la zor lam dbye/ /zhes brjod nas zor 'phen sar 'gro ba na/ kun gyis gdugs dkar gyi sngags brjod cing 'gro/ de nas zor 'phen sar slebs pa na gser skyems mchod cing sngar gyi bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs dang*/ zhes sogs kyi bzlog pa de gnyis gang rung brjod cing zor rnams 'phel ba las gzhan ma bshad cing*/ 'phen tshul paṇa chen gyi bzhed pa ltar na des chog par snang la/ 'phen pa'i tshe sngags gang brjod pa mi gsal yang gdugs dkar gyis sngags dang*/ phyag rdor gyi sngags oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi hūṃ phaṭa gdon bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sbrel nas brjod cing 'phangs na legs par sems/ slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍā go mi'i gdugs dkar gyi sngags ring bzlas nas tshe dang yungs dkar ba sngags nas 'phen par yang bshad/ dam pa kha cig rgyal dbang gi rnying ma'i phyogs su mdzad pa'i mdos zor 'phen tshul de 'dir kha bskang nas phyag len mdzad cing 'dod na de ltar rung tsam ste/ nges par dgos par mi snang bas ma bris/

zor 'phangs zin nas slob dpon gyis rting mnan pas nang du 'ongs te slar mchod bstod dang yig brgya bzod gsol dang gshegs gsol rnams bya dgos shing*/ de yang mchod 'bul dang bstod pa gong du brjod pa de dag las bsdus te bya la/ bzod gsol bsdus pa ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis bya zhing*/ rgyas pa ni rang gis ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin byas chog gshegs gsol ni oṃ khyos kyis bdag cag don mdzad cing*/ /'dod don sgrub pa kun nas legs/ /da ni mi dgyes med par ni/ /rang gi gnas su badz+ra muḥ mgron rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs par gyur ces brjod/ bkris ni spyi ltar bya'o// //'phros la bsdus pa bya tshul zhig brjod par ste/ de snga dkyil 'khor ni bsdu na pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du tshom bu bkod chog par paṇa chen rin po che'i cho ga las bshad cing*/ bsdus ba ni de nyid las 'byung ba dang bstun gzhan gzhung ltar la/ mdun bskyed spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar po can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang rang so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gnad la bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ zhes pa nas 'jigs pa ma lus pa las skyob pa'i bdag nyid can nyer gnyis phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ bgegs dang*/ gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa srid pa gsum gyi sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ ka ma la ye staṃ/ de nas mchod pa 'bul tshul sngar ltar rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang bstod pa'i bar byas nas/ /gtor ma gzhan 'bul tshul gong ltar la/ mi za dgu za'i gtor ma rnams cig car du 'bul tshul bsdus nas 'di ltar bshad de/

byin brlabs sngar ltar byas nas/ oṃ ru twa ye/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra/ zhes pa nas a su ra bh+ya na ga bh+ya de ba nā ga nas a ma nu ṣa sa pa ri wa ra bh+yo bi shwa nas ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong dang sde brgyad kyi sngags gnyis kyis lan bdun cig car du bsngos nas oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs kyis mchod de/ hūṃ/ phas rgol 'joms la mthu ldan gtso mo dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i phur bus thob la brlag par mdzod/ /ces 'phrin las bcol nas/ hūṃ khams gsum bdag po sprin sgron ma/ /zhes pa nas gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas dang*/ /zhes pa yan chad ni rgyas pa ltar bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor sa 'dzin rtse mo nas/ /legs 'khrungs rig sngags chen mo gdugs dkar gyi/ /bzlog chen ji ltar bya tshul 'od dkar can/ /gdon bgegs gnod mun sel phyir deng 'dir shar/ /gang 'di gzhan gyis dad pas bskul ba dang*/ /rang nyid lhag bsam dag pa'i kun slong gis/ /rgya bod gzhung nas 'byung ba'i dgongs don ltar/ /lag len gsal bar phye nas bkod pa nyid/ /tshul bzhin byas na gdon bgegs bar chad rnams/ /nye bar zhi 'gyur som nyi mi 'tshal yang*/ /'di la yo byad sna mang dgos pa'i phyir/ /mi 'byor lag len ji bzhin 'khyer ba dka'/ /'on kyang gang gis 'di ltar phyogs tsam zhig /sgrubs shing dad pas lag tu blangs byas na/ /gnod pa'i nad gdon bar chad phran tshegs rigs/ /zhi bar 'gyur la the tshom ci zhig yod/ /tsaṇ+ḍa go mi bzang po bkra shis dang*/ /paṇa chen gong ma nas brgyud bzlog chen 'di/ /sbyar ba'i dge des bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /gdon bgegs bar chad rigs las grol gyur cig /ces gdugs dkar gyi bzlog chen ji ltar bya tshul 'di yang*/ la mar nang gi sngags bon dad ldan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngo bor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/

dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i sbis mgu'i dge slong bzang po rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud grwar sngags ram pa'i mtshan gdags mdzad pa'i skabs su/ dpon slob kyi gsung tsam zhig par du brko bar bya zhes bskul ba'i tshe gzhan la phan ched dpe 'di par du brko rgyur byin pa ltar par du bsgrubs pa'i dge bas brko ba po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams nye bar zhi nas myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur cig par gyi yi ge pa ni spis mgu'i 'phags pa skyabs kyis so/ /maṅga laṃ// //
